configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server-Tags
configurationFields.description: Sets optional filter tags for the server that assist searching in the server browser. Available tags are listed in enshrouded_server_readme.txt

configurationFields.label: Spielergruppen und Passwörter
configurationFields.description: Permissions for groups of players, including passwords to join the server, can be defined via [server roles](https://enshrouded.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/19191581489309-Server-Roles-Configuration) in enshrouded_server.json. See enshrouded_server_readme.txt for further details

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Gesperrte Spieler
configurationFields.description: Players can be permanently banned from the server by accessing the banlist in-game via the Social-tab and adding them there. The banlist can also be edited directly by configuring 'bannedAccounts' in enshrouded_server.json - see enshrouded_server_readme.txt for format details

configurationFields.label: Sprachchat
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Sprachchat-Modus
configurationFields.description: Sets the mode for voice chat. Requires Voice Chat to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Textchat
configurationFields.description: If set, text chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Spielregel-Vorlage
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty setting for the game. If "Custom" is selected, the following individual gameplay settings can be configured. Otherwise the preset determines the gameplay settings

configurationFields.label: Lebenspunkte
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Mana
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Ausdauer
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Körperwärme
configurationFields.description: Scales the maximum body heat for players by the set factor. The higher the factor the longer the player can stay in very cold areas before hypothermia sets in

configurationFields.label: Tauchzeit
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Waffenhaltbarkeit
configurationFields.description: If set, weapons can be broken

configurationFields.label: Hunger und Verhungern
configurationFields.description: If set, hunger and starvation will be enabled. During starvation, a player will lose health periodically until death if no food or drink is consumed

configurationFields.label: Wirkungsdauer von Nahrung
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Zeit bis zum Verhungern
configurationFields.description: Set the length of the hungry state before starving sets in by configuring 'fromHungerToStarving' in enshrouded_server.json. Unit is nanoseconds (yes, really). Lowest = 300000000000, highest = 1200000000000

configurationFields.label: Aufenthaltsdauer im Miasma
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Verlust beim Tod
configurationFields.description: Sets what happens to backpack items when players die. Lost items are stored in a tombstone and can be recovered there

configurationFields.label: Gleiter-Turbulenzen
configurationFields.description: If set, the glider will be affected by air turbulences

configurationFields.label: Wetterhäufigkeit
configurationFields.description: Sets how often new weather phenomena appear in the game world

configurationFields.label: Schwierigkeit beim Angeln
configurationFields.description: Sets the strength of the fish during the fishing minigame. The stronger a fish is, the longer the minigame will proceed

configurationFields.label: Abbaueffektivität
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Pflanzenwachstum
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Ressourcenertrag
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Produktionsgeschwindigkeit
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Ertrag beim Waffen-Recycling
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Kosten für Waffenverbesserungen
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Kampferfahrung
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Abbauerfahrung
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Erfahrung durch Erkundung und Quests
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Anzahl der Gegner
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of enemies in the world. Automatic scales the enemy count with the number of players nearby

configurationFields.label: Gleichzeitig angreifende Gegner
configurationFields.description: Sets how many enemies are allowed to attack at the same time

configurationFields.label: Gegnerschaden
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Gegner-Lebenspunkte
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Betäubung von Gegnern
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Wahrnehmungsreichweite der Gegner
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Boss-Schaden
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Boss-Lebenspunkte
configurationFields.description: Multiplikator gegenüber dem normalen Spielwert.

configurationFields.label: Angriffshäufigkeit
configurationFields.description: Scales the frequency of enemy attacks. This excludes bosses. Minimum = 0.25

configurationFields.label: Friedliche Gegner
configurationFields.description: If set, enemies won't attack players until they are attacked. This excludes bosses

configurationFields.label: Folgen fehlgeschlagener Zähmung
configurationFields.description: Sets how the game reacts when a player startles wildlife during taming. Progress is visualized by hearts in the game

configurationFields.label: Tagesdauer
configurationFields.description: Set the length of daytime by configuring 'dayTimeDuration' in enshrouded_server.json. A smaller value equals shorter daytime. Unit is nanoseconds (yes, really). Lowest = 120000000000, highest = 3600000000000

configurationFields.label: Nachtdauer
configurationFields.description: Set the length of nighttime by configuring 'nightTimeDuration' in enshrouded_server.json. A smaller value equals shorter nighttime. Unit is nanoseconds (yes, really). Lowest = 120000000000, highest = 3600000000000

configurationFields.label: Fluchstärke
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the Shroud curse is off or the chance of receiving the curse when being attacked by the corresponding enemies is increased

configurationFields.label: Miasma-Entfernung durch Flammenaltäre
configurationFields.description: Sets the Flame level required to place Flame Altars into the Shroud. Range 1 to 11. Default = 11

configurationFields.label: Proton-GE-Version
configurationFields.description: Leer lassen, um die im Profil vorgesehene Version zu verwenden.

deploymentSteps.name: Enshrouded_server.json Download
deploymentSteps.source:
{
  "name": "GSCS Enshrouded Server",
  "saveDirectory": "./savegame",
  "logDirectory": "./logs",
  "ip": "0.0.0.0",
  "queryPort": 15637,
  "slotCount": 16,
  "tags": [],
  "voiceChatMode": "Proximity",
  "enableVoiceChat": false,
  "enableTextChat": false,
  "gameSettingsPreset": "Default",
  "gameSettings": {
    "playerHealthFactor": 1,
    "playerManaFactor": 1,
    "playerStaminaFactor": 1,
    "playerBodyHeatFactor": 1,
    "playerDivingTimeFactor": 1,
    "enableDurability": true,
    "enableStarvingDebuff": false,
    "foodBuffDurationFactor": 1,
    "fromHungerToStarving": 600000000000,
    "shroudTimeFactor": 1,
    "tombstoneMode": "AddBackpackMaterials",
    "enableGliderTurbulences": true,
    "weatherFrequency": "Normal",
    "fishingDifficulty": "Normal",
    "miningDamageFactor": 1,
    "plantGrowthSpeedFactor": 1,
    "resourceDropStackAmountFactor": 1,
    "factoryProductionSpeedFactor": 1,
    "perkUpgradeRecyclingFactor": 0.500000,
    "perkCostFactor": 1,
    "experienceCombatFactor": 1,
    "experienceMiningFactor": 1,
    "experienceExplorationQuestsFactor": 1,
    "randomSpawnerAmount": "Automatic",
    "aggroPoolAmount": "Normal",
    "enemyDamageFactor": 1,
    "enemyHealthFactor": 1,
    "enemyStaminaFactor": 1,
    "enemyPerceptionRangeFactor": 1,
    "bossDamageFactor": 1,
    "bossHealthFactor": 1,
    "threatBonus": 1,
    "pacifyAllEnemies": false,
    "tamingStartleRepercussion": "LoseSomeProgress",
    "dayTimeDuration": 1800000000000,
    "nightTimeDuration": 720000000000,
    "curseModifier": "Normal",
    "flameLevelFogRemoval": 11
  },
  "userGroups": [],
  "bannedAccounts": []
}
